items.note: S1.3.1a-c follow the proof at 741-765 exactly: rows 0-1 subtract Ja+Rc, net change (JV+RG)x, central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2 or (|S∩T|-1)/2 cancelled by the side injection, and (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x). The parameters h=100, N, m and the wire counts W_b, W_c (767-782) are never given.

S1.3.2 states the common frame per gate, the edge change, commutation with pointwise gates and the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, giving the paper's one-line reason (811-813). It is an infer step without the invariant argument, so it counts as stated.

The bilinear form, triple pairings, interstage consistency, side and central label chains, the single decrease at center 3->4, the telescoping and L=Ich all match 856-1071. The per-time gate-label table (eq:motif-labels) and residual table that verify every edge are not reproduced, and the lemma's orthonormal-basis claim over F_2 (1073-1102), needed for the complex interface, is omitted.

It gives the rank of P_V-P_U, the N exceptional source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one, s_b=Wm-N+2L with deficit N-2L>0, the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, and XOR gates permuting by rho, all as in 1156-1171. That the other roles have zero source and identity sink matrices is left implicit.

S2.1 gives the phase frames, one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m. It asserts C^{⊗m} on every role without the source and sink diagonal corrections and the undoing of the signed exchange, which the paper requires (1225-1227, 1287-1314); S2.3 mentions these corrections only in passing. The weight-additivity proof (1232-1259) is absent.

It gives L/N=100/539 and 101/539 below 1/2, s_b<W_b m, s_c<W_c m, and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} via m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50}). The exact deficits eta_b, eta_c are never computed, log m<20 is not stated, and the matching bound s_c/W_c<m^sigma is only used in S2.7d, not derived.
S1.1 and S1.2 state both lemmas' contents. S1.2's quote carries the b^{O(1)} offset-preparation condition. They are infer steps with no derivation.

The shear cost follows 1425-1443: triangular parts by descending controlled updates, and one interchange per one of Pi via D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j. The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 is only asserted (S1.3.7), without the elimination proof of 1375-1391, and the choice of a fixed odd prime q avoiding the denominators (1413-1423) is omitted.

The steps cover the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} edges by recursive interchanges, Phi_{I_m} on every row including scratch rows, the three-shear interchange, exactly s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the geometric-sum case split, and the depth-first parking schedule, matching 1491-1588.

It covers the high-digit row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, row padding, the base-m split with cost O(V) sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), the O(V log 2e) remaining movement, binary-to-radix-q padding and unequal widths, as in 1649-1762.

It gives the P_M^{-1}/slot kernels/P_M implementation, the inverse-child identity (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z^{⊗f} C^{⊗f} Z^{⊗f}, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes, corrections adding no calls, H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D, and the fixed number of row additions, matching 1867-1940. The conjugation identity P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} is used implicitly.

It covers the eight-operation parity cycles, the guard interval and no-carry argument, the union bound giving delta_bad, the fact that T_0 S_0^{-1} permutes only B, repair by extraction and radix sort, and the time bound, as in 2013-2207. The separate treatment of the top selected position j_{f-1} is omitted, a minor gap.

It covers rows from the first q_0 chunks padded to multiples of W^{k_0}, u=Wg+w with child volume V/W, the recurrence with leaves O(e), K<=e^{c/beta}, the geometric sum and leaf bound, and the base-m partition giving O(d^{lambda'}), matching 2306-2445.

The statement matches the proposition, and the guard-width derivation follows 2450-2584: A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with branching s, 8dB^{k+1}<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, C_0 d^{C_1} with C_1=20, exactness with p+Delta fractional bits. The single truncation is justified by absolute row sum one.

Character cancellation via k->k+t/2^{v+1}, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed storage, reverse recursion, the grouped round H then J_E, prefix moves O(TpdK), at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges, simultaneous rounds, error and stored order all match the paper.
It covers evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the |h_j|<B_0/2 bound, signed block encoding, centered extraction with carries, negacyclic wrap and the O(rp log(rp)) cost, as in 3233-3368.
It covers the convolution theorem normalization, P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the error 2delta+eta+delta scaled by M, and the cost of M=T/r products, matching 3414-3495.

It covers T P_s F_s=P_t F_t S, ||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta}<1/2, A=S/2 and B_0=D'J'C with the 2^{-2alpha^2} normalization, the error and time table, the permutations not executed, and the tensor and linewise implementation with axis-movement cost, as in 3600-3660 and 3800-3897.

The cancellation (RF_s^+)[(RF_s u)(RF_s v)]=(u*v)/S^2 is derived as in 3955-3980: the dilation identity, permutation commuting with products, and the normalized convolution rule. The chirp identity QF_t u = conj(a)·(a*(conj(a)·u))/T is only stated (S6, an infer step), without the paper's Bluestein derivation.

The fixed exponents, the layer conditions (checked: sigma+beta(1-sigma)=1-2^{-51}<lambda<lambda'), the sizes, alpha, gamma, eta, and the prime existence, bounds, product and search all match 4008-4170.
It covers the isomorphism argument, the triangular mixed-radix formula, descending-order controlled rotations preserving padding, and the axis-reversal cost, as in 4216-4296.
It covers the twist x_d->zeta y, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, M_C = D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g) = f*g/T as a contraction, and the computed version, matching 4303-4390.
It covers the source-transform composition and exact counterpart RF_s, the conjugate opposite procedure, the six steps, and the two occurrences of S undoing different normalizations, as in 4456-4540.
The error chain E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L, the final bound below 1/2, rounding and carries all follow 4575-4806.

It gives the seven margins with min g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa, the per-row justifications, setup and exceptional sorting as o(V), and the final O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}) with the schoolbook cutoff, matching 4837-4991.
S0 says the bound disproves the n log n conjecture in this model, but never states the eventual lower bound or that its negation needs liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0.

errors.says: The complex network with phase frames has endpoint operator C^{⊗m} on every role.
errors.paper: Telescoping the phase frames gives C^{⊗m} on every role only after source and sink diagonal corrections and undoing the signed bank exchange. On the route X_a->Y_a the raw operator is C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates of u_a and C elsewhere, fixed by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route. The fixed bank-exchange network (S1.3.1), frames (S1.3.2), nested subspace labels (S1.3.3), the dimension and rank budget s=Wm-N+2L<Wm (S1.3.4), the shear interface (S1.3.5) and recursive matrix shears (S1.3.7-8) give F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1)=O(e^tau) (S1.3.12). The complex counterpart feeds the layer recurrence (S2), then the transforms, resampling, chirp, CRT map, exact recovery and cost table (S3-S9). It thins where facts are asserted rather than derived: the fixed parameters h=100, N, m and the wire counts are never set out, the orthonormal-basis part of the label lemma and the complex interface's proof are only stated, the factorization lemma and the chirp identity are asserted, and the exact deficits eta and log m<20 are skipped in deriving tau.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored is stated and derived. The defining setup is missing: h=100, data pairs indexed by triples of triples, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear, though N and m are later used undefined. Marked conservatively.
It states a common invertible frame per gate commuting with pointwise gates, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and that each edge only changes frame.
It states nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} of dimension m, nested labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by P⊗F of dimension h.
It states that P_V-P_U has rank dim V - dim U, and that the N source edges 2P_{U_a} are the rank-one exceptions.
It states sum |Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich via telescoping, and s_b=Wm-N+2L.
It states L/N=100/539 (bit) and 101/539 (complex), both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L>0 and s<Wm.
It states that the terminal matrices differ by I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m), so the network applies H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
It states A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, a shear costing exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and exactly s recursive calls per node.

It states children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), tau=1-2^{-50} from a deficit above 20*2^{-50} and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50}), and F_k=O(e^tau). The bound log m<20 is used implicitly, not stated.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central chain from frames through labels, rank equals dimension change, the budget Wm-N+2L, the strict ratio 100/539, the endpoint identity, recursive shears and the recurrence giving e^tau. Only the setup of the fixed network is thin: the exchange is fully stated, but h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never defined.
